informal_statement: For a real \(\lambda\), the common-perimeter domain consists of the real \(p\) with \(p>2\lambda\pi\).
reason: `CMVBallCase.lean:1832-1840`: The formal type is the subtype of real \(p\) satisfying \(2\cdot \lambda \cdot \pi <p\). The author's open interval description is exact for arbitrary \(\lambda\); positive-radius solvability and inverses are subsequently restricted to admissible density.
